title: 2 Chronicles 2
paragraphs: ¹ Solomon decided to build a temple for the name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself. ² He conscripted seventy thousand men as laborers, eighty thousand as stonecutters in the hills, and three thousand six hundred as foremen over them. ³ Solomon sent a message to Huram king of Tyre: "Deal with me as you dealt with my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in. ⁴ I am now building a temple for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn fragrant incense before him, to set out the bread of the Presence, and to present burnt offerings every morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, at the new moon feasts, and at the appointed festivals of the LORD our God — this is a lasting obligation for Israel. ⁵ The temple I am building will be great, because our God is greater than all gods."

⁶ "But who can build a house worthy of him, when the heavens — even the highest heavens — cannot contain him? Who am I to build him a house, except to burn offerings before him? ⁷ Send me now a skilled craftsman who can work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue yarn, and who knows how to engrave — to work with the skilled craftsmen I have here in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided. ⁸ Send me also cedar, pine, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know your servants are expert at cutting timber in Lebanon. My servants will work alongside yours ⁹ to prepare plenty of timber for me, because the temple I am going to build must be large and magnificent. ¹⁰ As wages for your woodsmen who cut the timber, I will give twenty thousand cors of crushed wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of olive oil."

¹¹ Huram king of Tyre replied in a letter he sent to Solomon: "Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you their king." ¹² Huram added, "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son with good sense and discernment, who will build a temple for the LORD and a palace for his own kingdom. ¹³ I am sending you a skilled craftsman, Huram-Abi, a man of great ability. ¹⁴ His mother was from the daughters of Dan and his father was a man of Tyre. He is experienced in working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and timber, and in purple, blue, and crimson yarn and fine linen. He can also execute all kinds of engraving and carry out any design that is given to him. He will work alongside your craftsmen and the craftsmen of my lord, your father David. ¹⁵ Now let my lord send his servants the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine he promised —

¹⁶ and we will cut as much timber from Lebanon as you need and bring it down to you as rafts by sea to Joppa, and you can take it up to Jerusalem." ¹⁷ Solomon counted all the foreigners living in Israel, following the census his father David had taken, and found there were one hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred of them. ¹⁸ He assigned seventy thousand of them as carriers, eighty thousand as stonecutters in the hills, and three thousand six hundred as foremen to keep the people working.
